_comment: Real /ravenna/meter frame captured with audio flowing (Hapi MkII H96149). Stream(id 1) input ch0-3 is routed to D/A(id 60) output ch0-3 via _connections; the D/A custom.outs.attenuation is -400 (=-40.0 dB, gain 0.01). The D/A output meter therefore reads floor(StreamInput * 0.01) channel-by-channel, proving the level integers are LINEAR amplitude. Trimmed to the two modules that carry the calibration; arrays trimmed to the 4 active channels.
